thread:
ricardo: Kickoff with Zeon Health tomorrow — quick scope checklist: success criteria (latency / cost / accuracy), sample prompts & evals, auth + telemetry, and any enterprise blockers. Can we confirm?

alex: We can take this. For the POC I suggest two primary flows: chat (streaming) and embeddings. Latency target: <300ms p95 for chat at ~512 tokens. Cost guideline: aim for < $0.02 / 1k tokens for baseline. Will propose model variants.

jordan: Evals plan: collect ~50 representative user prompts + ~200 adversarial/edge cases. We'll run quality rubrics (exact-match, semantic-sim, hallucination checks). Timeline: 1 week to collect prompts, 1 week to run and iterate.

ricardo: Security / procurement questions from them: SAML for SSO, SCIM for accounts, and data residency in us-west. Also they asked about the infosec questionnaire — do we have an answers doc?

maria: Security note: For an initial POC hosted mode is OK if we do IP allowlist + customer-managed KMS. For enterprise SSO + SCIM we can plug into their IdP. I'll upload the filled questionnaire and the ATO checklist. Also need to confirm logs retention and deletion policy. :white_check_mark:

alex: Integration details (short):
- SDK: use @redwood/inference-js (examples in repo).
- Auth: API key in Authorization header for POC demo; for long term use OAuth/SSO.
- Streaming: support SSE and websockets. Example SSE curl:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-chat-1","input":"Summarize patient intake notes"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
- Retries: make requests idempotent with request_id header; client-side exponential backoff up to 4 attempts.
- Quotas: default 120 rps per API key; burst token bucket allows short spikes ~300 rps. We can request quota increases for the POC.

jordan: On evals/quality: we'll run a quantization comparison (fp16 vs int8/quant) on a 100-prompt subset. If regression > 2% on key metrics we won't ship that quant profile.

ricardo: Pricing Q from Zeon: can we cap monthly spend and set alerting/soft-deny? Also: how do overage charges look if they exceed quota?

jordan: Yes — we can set a hard quota cap per API key and a webhook alert on 80/90/100% thresholds. Overage policy: defaults to blocked until billing update unless they opt into auto-topup; sales can propose committed tiers for Dedicated. I'll share a cost-sim spreadsheet.

deploy-bot: uploaded: https://redwood.internal/poc/zenhealth-telemetry-and-answers.pdf

maria: Next steps from security side: I'll attach the questionnaire answers here and draft a short SOW blurb listing POC deliverables (timebox: 3 weeks, two evaluation checkpoints). Need legal + sales to confirm wording for data handling.

ricardo: Great — can someone drop the prompt set + test harness (simple harness that runs streamed chat + logs tokens) by EOD? :eyes:

alex: On it. I'll push sample prompt JSON, a small Node runbook, and an auth snippet to the shared drive by 5pm PT.

jordan: I'll schedule a sync with their engineering lead for Thu 3pm PT and include the checklist: auth, quotas, streaming test, prompt set signoff.

ricardo: Thanks team :thumbsup:
